title: Old Lumiere - Expedition 33 Area Guide (Bosses, Loot & Tips)
description: Old Lumiere in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - how to reach it, the bosses inside, the weapons and Pictos you can find, and what to watch out for.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: The ruined old city, with an unmistakable bent Eiffel Tower. It is where Act 2 opens and where a set of merchant weapons become available.

sections.title: How to Reach Old Lumiere
sections.content: Reached at the start of Act 2. It connects to the Monolith route.

sections.title: Collectibles & Notable Loot
sections.content: Danseso, Redalim, Algueron, Mellarum, Chromatic Danseuse drop
